title: Optimal Convergence of Quadratic Not-a-Knot Spline Interpolation on Arbitrary Partitions
summary: The not-a-knot condition provides a simple spline interpolation scheme that requires no derivative data at the endpoints. Whereas the classical not-a-knot scheme using odd-degree splines selects knots that coincide with the data points, this approach does not extend to the even-degree case. In this paper we establish the well-posedness of the not-a-knot interpolation problem for even-degree splines, where knots are selected at midpoints of data values.
